entities.subtitle: Traffic stop during a search for a silver hatchback
entities.description: On November 2, 2026, officers reviewing video described a silver car that might have been a hatchback. An officer reported following a similar-looking car after it left a parking lot. On Law 2, an officer reported that the driver initially did not stop near Pleasant Grove Boulevard. A few minutes later, an officer reported that the scene appeared secure. Back on car-to-car, officers relayed a more specific description of the car they were seeking, possibly a light-colored Toyota Yaris, and said the car and driver involved in the stop did not match the ones they were looking for.
